summary: The vars lookup takes the variable names to resolve and an optional default to return for undefined variables; without a default, undefined names cause an error.
questions: How do I avoid an error when a dynamically named variable doesn't exist?
What happens if the vars lookup asks for an undefined variable?
How do I set a fallback value in the vars lookup?

answer_card.title: vars lookup parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_terms` (required): variable names to look up
- `default`: value returned when a variable is undefined. Without it, any undefined variable causes an **error**.
